name: vision
description: Visual analyst — reads the actual content of images (screenshots, diagrams, charts, photos, text inside pictures). You cannot see images yourself: when a question is about what an image shows, delegate it here and name the exact local file path of the image to inspect (e.g. C:\Users\...\shot.png or j:\ai\...\chart.png). It runs on a vision model and calls view_image on the path; only image-content questions go here, never byte/metadata questions (those stay in run_command).
